search_topic: answering bioinformatics data analysis questions (BixBench) with pandas and scipy statistics
brief: an analysis script (`analysis.py`) that answers 17 BixBench questions (question text and dataset previews are under Task inputs) from 3 raw datasets in data/ and prints {question_id: number}; loss = 1 - accuracy. Round-by-round feedback grades 10 development questions; the remaining 7 are reserved for one final held-out test. BixBench's published full-benchmark accuracy of 0.523 is reference context, not directly comparable to this split. The sandbox has numpy, pandas, scipy, statsmodels, openpyxl (no network)

from scipy import stats


def two_sample_power(n, d, alpha=0.05):
    df, shift = 2 * n - 2, d * (n / 2) ** 0.5
    crit = stats.t.ppf(1 - alpha / 2, df)
    return stats.nct.sf(crit, df, shift) + stats.nct.cdf(-crit, df, shift)


n_per_group = next(n for n in range(2, 100_000) if two_sample_power(n, cohen_d) >= 0.8)
answers["bix-19-q1"] = n_per_group
answers["bix-19-q5"] = n_per_group

import numpy as np


def ols_rss(columns, y):
    design = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(y)), *columns])
    beta = np.linalg.lstsq(design, y, rcond=None)[0]
    return float(((y - design @ beta) ** 2).sum()), design.shape[1]


hemi = (neun.Hemispere == "KD").to_numpy(float)
sex = (neun.Sex == neun.Sex.unique()[0]).to_numpy(float)
y_neun = neun.NeuN.to_numpy(float)
rss_full, k_full = ols_rss([hemi, sex, hemi * sex], y_neun)
rss_main = ols_rss([hemi, sex], y_neun)[0]
answers["bix-19-q4"] = (rss_main - rss_full) / (rss_full / (len(y_neun) - k_full))

fake_edits.idea: Fit the Age logistic model for bix-51-q1/q6/q8
fake_edits.new:
import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

x51 = pd.read_excel("data/data.xlsx")
x51 = x51[pd.to_numeric(x51["Age"], errors="coerce").notna() & x51["Efficacy"].notna()].copy()
x51["Age"] = x51["Age"].astype(float)
pr = (x51["Efficacy"].astype(str).str.strip() == "PR").to_numpy(float)


def logit(columns):
    """Newton-Raphson logistic regression of PR: (coefficients, Wald p-values, AIC)."""
    design = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(pr)), *columns]).astype(float)
    beta = np.zeros(design.shape[1])
    for _ in range(50):
        p = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-design @ beta))
        hessian = design.T @ (design * (p * (1 - p))[:, None])
        beta += np.linalg.solve(hessian, design.T @ (pr - p))
    p = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-design @ beta))
    loglik = float((pr * np.log(p) + (1 - pr) * np.log(1 - p)).sum())
    pvalues = 2 * stats.norm.sf(np.abs(beta / np.sqrt(np.diag(np.linalg.inv(hessian)))))
    return beta, pvalues, 2 * design.shape[1] - 2 * loglik


age_beta, _, age_aic = logit([x51["Age"]])
answers["bix-51-q1"] = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-(age_beta[0] + age_beta[1] * 65)))
answers["bix-51-q6"] = age_aic
answers["bix-51-q8"] = age_beta[1]
